workarounds.symptom: tool.Registry.Clone shares schema maps between cached registries
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tool): deep-copy schema maps when cloning a registry. Target files: agent/internal/tool/registry.go, agent/internal/tool/registry_test.go. `tool.Registry.Clone` copied the tool map with `maps.Copy`, which copies each `RegisteredTool` struct. Its `ToolDefinition.Parameters` map — and every nested `properties` map — stayed shared between the clone and the source. `agent/session_tool_registry.go` caches a built profile registry and hands sessions `cached.Clone()`, so two registries from one cache shared schema maps. (Ref: https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/evener/pull/6388)
